$comment: PROJECT-WIDE, CHECKED IN. Applies to every agent session in this repo.
The PreToolUse hook below refuses any `firebase deploy` that would touch
Hosting while firebase.json is missing the VLink rewrites. On 2026-08-10 a
stale firebase.json (restored from an older branch that predated VLink) was
deployed roughly ten times. Firebase Hosting REPLACES the whole config on
every deploy, so each one deleted the /vlink -> vlinkApp rewrite.
vergr.app/vlink then fell through the catch-all and served the Vergr SPA.
The Shopify reviewer saw a blank page and rejected the app.
This is a hook rather than a note because a note already existed and did
not stop it. The guard also runs as firebase.json's `predeploy`, which
catches a deploy run by anyone or anything, not just an agent.
